translation: (Obtaining magnolia bark 厚朴 and coptis 黃連 stops abdominal pain; obtaining schisandra 五味子, 牡蒙, and oyster 牡蠣 enables one to bear children. Obtaining astragalus 黃芪, 白蘞, and red beans 赤小豆 treats rat fistulas. Cornus 山茱萸 and dragon bone 龍骨 are its envoys; it is averse to 蔥實 and is in dread of salvia 丹參 and peony 牡丹, ...
